Title: 
Mid Software Engineer 
 
 Belong. Connect. Grow. with KBR! 
 
 KBR’s National Security Solutions team provides high-end engineering and advanced technology solutions to our customers in the intelligence and national security communities. In this position, your work will have a profound impact on the country’s most critical role – protecting our national security.
 
 KBR, is seeking a highly motivated Mid Software Engineer to join us in supporting our great nation, supporting the Air Force Research Laboratory (AFRL) development team in Colorado Springs, CO.
 
 Why Join Us?  
 Innovative Projects : At KBR, you'll be working on prototype projects that support the U.S. Air Force Research Laboratory’s most mission-critical objectives. The Air Force Research Laboratory is the primary scientific research and development center for the Department of the Air Force. AFRL plays an integral role in leading the discovery, development, and integration of affordable warfighting technologies for our air, space, and cyberspace force.  
 Collaborative Environment : KBR fosters a dynamic and collaborative atmosphere where cross-functional teams of product managers, engineers, developers, and defense experts work in unison. We practice Agile and DevOps principles, ensuring rapid iteration, continuous feedback, and integration across all projects. Our team is passionate, forward-thinking, and united by a mission-first mindset that encourages knowledge sharing, innovation, and problem-solving at every level. 
 Impactful Work : Your work here won’t just be limited to software development—it will directly support the Air Force in expanding current national capabilities. As the Air Force's leader for National-to-Tactical capability development, AFRL collaborates with leading experts across the Intelligence Community, Department of Defense, National Laboratories, industry, inter-agency, academia, and partner nations. 
 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Design, develop, and maintain software for high-velocity data stream processing systems
 Implement features and enhancements from requirements through delivery
 Write clean, efficient, and maintainable code with an emphasis on performance and reliability
 Develop and execute unit and integration tests to ensure software quality
 Participate in code reviews and contribute to shared coding standards and best practices
 Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions
 Troubleshoot and resolve software issues across development and production environments
 Create prototypes and contribute to software architecture discussions
 Generate and maintain technical documentation and project artifacts
 
 Work Environment: 
 Location: Colorado Springs, CO – 100% Onsite or Beavercreek, OH – 100% Onsite
 Travel Requirements: Minimal
 Working Hours: Standard
 
 Required Qualifications: 
 3–5 years of professional software development experience
 Experience across the full software development lifecycle
 2+ years of hands-on experience with Java, Python, or another object-oriented programming language
 Experience building software systems emphasizing throughput, reliability, and availability
 Experience developing data processing or integration solutions supporting multiple message formats (XML, Protocol Buffers, etc.)
 Experience with version control, collaboration tools, and modern software engineering practices
 
 Required Education and Experience: 
 Active U.S. Government Top Secret / SCI security clearance (U.S. citizenship required)
 Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, or related technical field
 
 Desired Qualifications: 
 Master's degree in Computer Science or related field
 Working knowledge of MIL-STD-6016 and MIL-STD-3011
 Experience applying TDD principles
 Agile development experience
 Security+ certification
 Strong curiosity, adaptability, and problem-solving skills
 
 Basic Compensation: 
 $92,700 - $139,000 (For the Colorado Springs, CO Area Only) 
 $88,200 - $132,300 (For the Beavercreek, OH Area Only) 
The offered rate will be based on the selected candidate’s knowledge, skills, abilities and/or experience and in consideration of internal parity.
 
 Additional Compensation: 
 KBR may offer bonuses, commissions, or other forms of compensation to certain job titles or levels, per internal policy or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be in the form of a sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short-term incentives, long-term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.
 
 
 
 Belong, Connect and Grow at KBR

At KBR, we are passionate about our people and our Zero Harm culture.  These inform all that we do and are at the heart of our commitment to, and ongoing journey toward being a People First company.  That commitment is central to our team of team’s philosophy and fosters an environment where everyone can Belong, Connect and Grow. We Deliver – Together. 
 
 KBR is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, veteran status, genetic information, union status and/or beliefs, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.
